description: Chart mode grounds a multi-tenant idea against known repo strategy and implementation pointers; emits a Grounding Snapshot with cited known_facts before any create.

expected.verdict: CHART_VERDICT=NO_WORK chart=<id> decision=- reason="grounded map persisted; background cited under Notes only"
notes: Background stays under Notes with citations
